The '''4.2FC fusion power core''' was a type of [[Power core/Legends|power core]] manufactured by [[Republic Engineering Corporation]]. A massive and powerful fusion core, a single 4.2FC was used to provide power to [[Loronar Defense Industries]]' [[MAS-2xB]] mobile [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]].<ref name="EGWT" />
